summary: Backfill in batches of 10,000 with short pauses.

stages.description: Add the column as nullable (metadata only).
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in boolean

stages.description: Short transactions; writers wait at most one batch.
sql: WITH batch AS (SELECT id FROM account_user WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL LIMIT 10000) UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = false FROM batch WHERE account_user.id = batch.id

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.

sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET DEFAULT false
